title: 高松宮記念の後に・それが私の選択

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I win the Takamatsunomiya Kinen, which means I beat King… Even so, she holds her head high, proud to have run valiantly until the very end!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: What's more, she sees through my hesitation and tells me to take pride in being myself!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I must stop being afraid of hurting others and behave in a way that's true to myself! I decide to participate in the talk show at the Fan Fest as a way to show my conviction.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's scary, of course, but I have someone by my side who reassures me that I'm not alone!
